name: Kochi (Cochin) — Arabian Sea shelf
establishment: Southern Naval Command; NPOL (Naval Physical & Oceanographic Laboratory, sonar/acoustics)
region: Arabian Sea, south-west India continental shelf

water.source: representative post-monsoon regional climatology (INCOIS / World Ocean Atlas means)

current.type: West India Coastal Current (seasonally reversing: poleward in winter, equatorward in summer monsoon)
current.source: representative WICC magnitude from regional literature / INCOIS surface-current climatology

sea_state.note: fair-weather; SW monsoon far rougher (Hs 2-3 m)

acoustics.note: Arabian Sea: saline, warm surface -> downward-refracting c-profile; NPOL sonar relevance

notes: All attacks run here; the site sets the ENVIRONMENT (current, density, sound-speed), not the attack set.
